breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained conflicting instructions for the numerical method, specifying both 'Explicit forward Euler' and 'Strang splitting'. The ground truth resolved this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction, as the detailed Strang splitting steps are the correct method. The agent failed to fix this inconsistency and repeated both conflicting instructions: 'Use the Explicit forward Euler time integration method.' and 'Implement the Strang splitting method...'
